title: observability: token/KV metrics & tracing dashboard + alert tuning and logging refinements
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR improves token-level and KV-cache observability by: 1) adding a consolidated Token/KV Metrics & Tracing dashboard that surfaces per-route token cost, avg token latency, KV cache hit/miss breakdown, and tail latency percentiles; 2) tuning alert thresholds and notification policies to reduce noisy alerts while keeping SLO coverage; 3) refining logging for the KV collector to include structured keys (route_id, model_variant, cache_key_shard) and move verbose debug logs behind a sampling flag; and 4) small fixes to tracing spans to ensure consistent parent IDs across async batching paths. Motivation: recent oncall noise and a regression where KV cache misses spiked without clear tracing linkage (see ENG-8245). The dashboard provides a single-pane overview to correlate cost/latency with cache efficiency and tracing spans. Changes follow the observability playbook: dashboards (Grafana) added/updated, alert rules tuned (PagerDuty escalation window updates), collector instrumentation improved, and docs updated with runbook guidance. Checklist: - [x] Metrics added and validated against synthetic traffic - [x] Traces linked to metrics through trace_id propagation - [x] Alerts tuned and reviewed with SRE - [x] Docs and runbook updated - [x] CI green (one flaky unit test was rerun and passed)

Li Wang: Can we reduce alert sensitivity for 95th latency to avoid noisy PD pages? Suggested 95th -> 99th shift and longer evaluation window - tuned and documented rationale;
Sophie Kim: KV collector sampling flag looks good, but please ensure default remains off for customers with compliance needs - added config and note in docs;
Ava Martinez: addressed review comments, split the biggest panels for readability, and added a short runbook section describing immediate triage steps
release_notes: Enhance observability: new Token/KV overview dashboard, tuned token-latency and KV-miss alerts to reduce noise, improved KV collector structured logging and tracing propagation. See docs/observability/token_kv.md for runbook and migration notes.
summary_changes: Consolidated token and KV metrics into a single dashboard, introduced new aggregation rules for per-route token cost, adjusted alert thresholds and PD escalation, made KV logging structured and optionally sampled, and fixed tracing parent propagation in async batch paths.
